title: 2019-06-18 MoM Workshop PowerBI - Accounts and usage
content:
Date

Attendees

  • - IT Architect IPEX

  • - Stand in for Joakim Mårtensson
  • - IPEX Analytics

Goals

Martin will present how we can use Power BI to have an overview of accounts in Azure and their status.

We will discuss requirements from IPEX for a MVP to have this data presented in PowerBI

Discussion items

TimeItemWhoNotes
5min

Martin presents charts for IPEX Azure subscriptions in Power BI

Martin presented a couple of diagrams that showed for example diagram for cost for IPEX Azure subscriptions. In Power BI it is possible to visualize data from Azure.

Discussion of what is next steps

It makes sens to start small and create charts in attached picture

  • Cost by subscription
  • Cost by product
  • Accumulated cost by subscription

There are several tools that can be used to visualize this data Power BI, Qlik sense, Grafana, Kibana...

Advantages by prototyping the diagrams above in Power BI is that we can get feedback and document requirements. It is a small first step that takes us in the right direction. Power BI is a tool that might be used by IPEX Analytics.

Second step include:

  • Should we use one tool to visualize data in that case which?
  • If needed create a common data store for all Azure subscriptions and AWS accounts
  • Create above view for all IPEX Azure subscriptions and AWS accounts

Action items

1 complete Talk to  if it is OK to share EA API key for cost and subscription data with IPEX. 42 complete Create diagrams for IPEX Subscriptions cost last month, IPEX Subscriptions cost accumulated, IPEX services cost 44 complete Check how we can share Power BI charts 43 complete Book meeting after summer to look at IPEX Power BI charts
